scope: Four-scene development pilot, not held-out or publication validation
input_policy: All 24 native RGB frames; no reference intrinsics, poses, depth, masks, normals, or object motion as inputs
settings: Same pinned checkpoints and 252-resolution inference settings as the completed DAVIS camera runs; no parameter selection on this pilot
accounting: All eight planned attempts retained, including process failures and invalid outputs; no scene replacement
reference_policy: Reference arrays only for separate subsequent evaluation; existing visibility diagnostics are not exact labels
claim_policy: No DNF threshold, camera ranking, or evaluator advantage inferred from process completion
